lines.t: I heard you say, come to me All who are weary and burdened, I'll give you peace
Take my yoke, learn from me Gentle and humble, rest for your soul when you're weak
For my yoke is easy, my burden is light You reached out your hand and said
The healthy don't need a physician instead I came for the sick, not the righteous
But sinners in need of repentance, the ones you never forget
In the beginning you rescued me
I know I was broken, I know I was weak
But that was years ago, honestly
I thought I'd be farther than where I'm still at
I know I was a sinner in need of your grace
I found you once, am I in the same place?
You say my grace is sufficient for you
My strength is perfected and weakness too
But oh Lord, I'm asking you
Why do these fleshly desires still pull me through?
Shouldn't I be farther by now?
I know you saved me, I know you pulled me out
I still feel bound by these chains that you say are only threats
Shouldn't I be farther by now?
Past these desires weighing me down
I trust your word, I just don't know how
I'm still in need of rescue somehow
I was a sheep battered on every side You stepped in once, pulled me out alive
You roared over the walls away from me I stood in the light, I was finally free
But now I'm back in that familiar place I'm still standing but I'm asking again
Lord, why do I need to hear your roar like that?
If you already saved me once Why do I need your rescue again?
If you already saved me once Why do I need your rescue again?
If you already call me yours, why do I need your roar again?
Shouldn't I be farther by now?
Still fighting battles I should have outgrown
Yet through it all, somehow you're still here
Calling my eyes back on you
Asking me to partake of you
As more of you rushes in
And less of me remains
Still in me
Still beneath you, being changed
Still you're, still you're, still safe
But shouldn't I be
Farther than me
